All Classes and Interfaces

Class
Description
AbstractAction
The AbstractAction class provides a base implementation for actions in a planning domain, including preconditions and effects.
AbstractAssociationRuleMiner
Abstract class for mining association rules from a Boolean database.
AbstractItemsetMiner
Abstract class for mining itemsets from a Boolean database.
AbstractSolver
An abstract class representing a solver for a constraint satisfaction problem (CSP).
Action
The Action interface represents an action that can be applied within a planning context.
Apriori
Implementation of the Apriori algorithm for mining frequent itemsets from a Boolean database.
ArcConsistency
Implements the Arc Consistency (AC) algorithm to enforce consistency on a constraint satisfaction problem (CSP).
AssociationRule
Represents an association rule in the context of association rule mining.
AssociationRuleMiner
Interface for association rule mining algorithms.
AStarPlanner
AStarPlanner is an A* search algorithm implementation for the Blocks World problem.
BacktrackSolver
Implements a Backtracking algorithm to solve a Constraint Satisfaction Problem (CSP).
BasicAction
The BasicAction class represents a simple action in a planning domain, with defined preconditions and effects.
BasicGoal
BasicGoal defines a goal state for the Blocks World planning problem.
BFSPlanner
BFSPlanner is an implementation of the Planner interface that uses Breadth-First Search (BFS) to find a sequence of actions that transform the initial state of a Blocks World into the target goal state.
BooleanDatabase
Represents a Boolean database for association rule mining.
BooleanVariable
Represents a boolean variable in the Blocks World model.
BruteForceAssociationRuleMiner
A brute-force implementation of an association rule miner that generates rules based on frequent itemsets.
BWActionsBuilder
The BWActionsBuilder class is responsible for creating and storing a set of basic actions that can be performed in the Blocks World model, given a specified number of blocks and stacks.
BWBasicConstraintsBuilder
The BWBasicConstraintsBuilder class is responsible for defining fundamental constraints in the Blocks World model.
BWCroissanceConstraintsBuilder
The BWCroissanceConstraintsBuilder class is responsible for creating constraints in the Blocks World model that enforce a rule of growth or ordering among blocks.
BWRegularyConstraintsBuilder
The BWRegularyConstraintsBuilder class is responsible for creating regularity constraints for the Blocks World model.
BWVariablesBuilder
The BWVariablesBuilder class is responsible for creating and managing the variables used in the Blocks World problem.
Constraint
This interface represents a constraint in a constraint satisfaction problem (CSP).
DataminingVariableBuilder
The DataminingVariableBuilder class is responsible for creating and managing boolean variables that represent the state of the Blocks World.
DFSPlanner
DFSPlanner is an implementation of the Planner interface that uses Depth-First Search (DFS) to find a sequence of actions leading from an initial state of blocks to a goal state in a Blocks World.
DifferenceConstraint
This class represents a constraint that ensures two blocks are placed on different locations.
DijkstraPlanner
DijkstraPlanner implements a planner that uses Dijkstra's algorithm to search for the optimal sequence of actions from the initial state to a goal state in the Blocks World.
DomainSizeVariableHeuristic
Implements a heuristic for selecting variables based on the size of their domains.
Goal
Represents a goal in a planning model.
Heuristic
Represents a heuristic function for estimating the cost or distance to reach a goal from a given state in a planning model.
HeuristicMACSolver
Implements a constraint satisfaction problem (CSP) solver that combines a heuristic-based approach with Maintaining Arc Consistency (MAC) during the search process.
Implication
 
InstanceComparator
Comparator for comparing two instances of StateWithDistance based on their cost.
Itemset
Represents an itemset in the context of association rule mining.
ItemsetMiner
Interface for mining itemsets from a Boolean database.
MACSolver
Implements a constraint satisfaction problem (CSP) solver using the Maintaining Arc Consistency (MAC) algorithm.
MisplacedBlockHeuristic
MisplacedBlockHeuristic calculates a heuristic estimate based on the number of misplaced blocks relative to a target goal state in the Blocks World.
NbConstraintsVariableHeuristic
Heuristic for selecting the most or least constrained variable based on the number of constraints in which it is involved.
Planner
Interface representing a planner in an automated planning system.
RandomValueHeuristic
A heuristic for ordering values in a random order for a given variable's domain.
SimilarityHeuristic
This class defines a heuristic based on the similarity between a given state and a goal state in the Blocks World model.
Solver
Interface for a general solver in a constraint satisfaction problem (CSP).
StateWithDistance
Represents a state in the planning process, along with its associated cost.
ValueHeuristic
Interface for a value heuristic used in constraint satisfaction problems (CSP).
Variable
Represents a variable in the Blocks World model.
VariableHeuristic
Interface for a variable heuristic used in constraint satisfaction problems (CSP).
WellplacedBlockHeuristic
WellplacedBlockHeuristic calculates a heuristic estimate based on the number of correctly placed blocks relative to a target goal state in the Blocks World.
